1.consolidated_definition: Entretenimiento, juego, que dispone que se venden los ojos a uno de los participantes hasta que coge a otro o lo reconoce al tocarlo, pasando entonces este a ser el vendado.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Blind Man's Bluff, a form of entertainment or game in which the eyes of one participant are covered until they touch another player, at which point that person becomes the blindfolded individual.
